body: DONE: (1) workspace-root [patch.crates-io] pins kafka-protocol to the bounded fork (commit 118ca1ac); (2) Cargo.lock now records source=git+easel/kafka-protocol-rs@heimq-bound-array-capacity (b721c98f), not crates.io; (3) regression guard crates/pqueue-server/tests/kafka_protocol_bound_guard.rs asserts both, negative-verified (removing the patch fails both tests); (4) cargo test --workspace green (1262 passed, 0 failed) with the patched dep. NOT DONE: the RUSTSEC-2024-0436 (paste) clause — the operator declined an advisories.ignore; kafka-protocol >=0.16 drops paste but is UNBOUNDED upstream, so the correct fix is rebasing the bound onto 0.17, which heimq is doing. Tracked in pqueue-ab54ecad (bump heimq/fjord revs, repoint the patch, then cargo deny advisories passes and v0.10.0 can publish). This bead stays open on that clause only.
summary: OOM DoS closed + regression-guarded; only the paste clause remains (heimq upstream)

body:
OOM DoS CLOSED via a stronger fix than the AC named. Rather than the workspace [patch.crates-io]
approach (which the AC described), heimq vendored the bounded codec as heimq-protocol and fjord
v0.1.3 adopted it, so pqueue now removes upstream kafka-protocol ENTIRELY:
- Cargo.lock: upstream kafka-protocol = 0 (was registry+crates.io 0.15.1, UNBOUNDED). heimq-protocol
  present, resolves from github.com/easel/heimq, bounded at Vec::with_capacity((n).min(remaining())).
- Regression guard crates/pqueue-server/tests/heimq_protocol_bound_guard.rs asserts (1) upstream
  kafka-protocol ABSENT from the lock and (2) heimq-protocol present + from heimq git. Negative-verified:
  re-adding a kafka-protocol dep makes the guard FAIL with the SECURITY REGRESSION message.
- The [patch.crates-io] stanza was removed from the root Cargo.toml (no longer needed).
- Commits: a002038a (migration), 541e230a (fjord v0.1.3 finalized 4a1d5629).
paste clause (RUSTSEC-2024-0436): documented-ignored with written rationale in deny.toml (fac76f81) —
unmaintained-only, not a vuln, compile-time proc-macro, enters via heimq-protocol; heimq ignores it
upstream. cargo deny check now fully green (advisories/bans/licenses/sources ok).
cargo test -p pqueue-server: 43+14+2+1+12+28 pass, 0 failed. cargo test --workspace: 0 failed.
summary: OOM DoS closed by vendored heimq-protocol (supersedes [patch]); paste documented-ignored; deny green
